title: 5BR Luxury Retreat in Inlet Beach, with a Private Pool
h1: Southern Seaside Cottage and Carriage House
meta_description: Private heated pool with elevator & carriage house steps from Rosemary Beach and Sleeps 16.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love • Rosemary Adjacent — borders Rosemary Beach • Minutes walk to the beach via Winston Lane • Private heated pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax) • Newly remodeled with luxury finishes and premium appliances • Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, and KitchenAid range • Elevator access to all 3 floors • Smart home features and HDTVs in every bedroom • Parking for 3 vehicles • 6 complimentary bikes • Beach Towels IncludedWelcome to Southern Seaside Cottage & Carriage House, a newly remodeled luxury retreat where modern coastal style meets classic Southern charm. Perfectly situated in beautiful Inlet Beach and just steps from the edge of Rosemary Beach, this elegant beach home comfortably accommodates up to sixteen guests across two connected residences. With high-end finishes, a private pool, and a prime location near the Gulf, it offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and laid-back luxury.On the first floor of the main house, the open-concept layout connects a spacious living area with a gourmet kitchen and dining space. A large sectional sofa anchors the living room, offering the perfect place to gather for movie nights or afternoon naps. The kitchen features luxury appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, KitchenAid range, and wine fridge. Sliding doors lead to a serene, enclosed courtyard with a private heated pool, ideal for sunny afternoons or quiet evenings under the stars. A half bathroom is also located on this level for added convenience.Upstairs on the second floor, two stylish king bedrooms each offer ensuite bathrooms, along with a charming twin bunk nook that provides a cozy hideaway for children. This level also includes a laundry area and access to a spacious wraparound porch that extends the living space outdoors.The third floor features two more luxurious king suites, both with private ensuite bathrooms. Each room is designed with tranquility in mind, offering smart TVs, plush bedding, and refined décor. This floor serves as a peaceful retreat for rest and privacy at the end of each day.The carriage house adds flexible living space with its own full kitchen, living area with a sleeper sofa, and a private queen bedroom. Sliding glass doors open to the courtyard and pool, creating a seamless connection between the two homes. Upstairs, guests will find a quiet queen suite with a private ensuite bath and peaceful views of the pool below.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 16)MAIN HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR • Open-concept living space with large sectional and TV • Gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero fridge, Bosch dishwasher, KitchenAid range, and wine fridge • Dining table for 8 and kitchen island seating for 2 • Private courtyard with heated pool • Half bathroomSECOND FLOOR • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom with shower/tub combo & Balcony Access • King bedroom • Hall Bath w/ Stand alone shower • Custom twin bunk nook for children with 2 twin/twin bunk beds • Laundry area with full-size washer and dryerTHIRD FLOOR • King primary suite with ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower & stand-alone tub • King suite with an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower & a stand-alone tubCARRIAGE HOUSE (Sleeps 4): • Fully equipped kitchen • Open living space with sleeper sofa and TV • Full bathroom with stand alone shower • Queen bedroomRear Dining for 6 & Propane GrillTDT-073698STR-073698
